encoding_limitation: the registered discriminator_table capability can only emit insufficient_features (or preserve_alternatives) for anything unmatched; the evidence-specific abstention reasons declared here are therefore DECLARED-BUT-UNREACHABLE pending a keyed-evidence capability -- kept as the unit's honest abstention vocabulary, not as consumer behavior (audit finding, modeled on inc-hamza-carrier-licensing)

functions.name: sun letter with an observed shadda: assimilation completed
moon letter: gemination is structurally excluded

rules.text: the closed sun-letter set (fourteen letters) and the closed moon-letter set (fourteen letters) partition the consonants that can follow the article; membership decides only whether assimilation is even possible, never whether it happened

an assimilation-completed claim additionally requires an OBSERVED written shadda on the following letter; a sun-letter context with no observed shadda withholds the claim rather than assuming an unmarked text still assimilated

a moon-letter context resolves as non-assimilating from membership alone, since gemination there is structurally excluded; an observed shadda on a moon letter contradicts the closed inventory and is refused, never explained away

the article's written laam stays article-owned in every resolved outcome; assimilation is a pronunciation fact about that laam, never a re-attribution of it to the following consonant, and never evidence of a doubled root or a Form II stem
no declared article evidence means the table is out of regime; it never activates on a bare following-letter observation alone
